Why pediatricians & endocrinologists warn against bedtimes after 10:00 PM 📏🧬

70% of a child's daily pulsatile Human Growth Hormone (HGH) is secreted during deep Slow-Wave Sleep between 10 PM and 2 AM (JCEM). Staying up on a tablet or eating late carbs spikes insulin and suppresses nocturnal HGH by up to 52%.
